<?php
// Legacy shop configuration (circa 2016). Deliberately typical of old PayPal integrations:
// credentials live in code with fallback values, and the API is the classic NVP endpoint.
// MIGRATED: Credentials now come ONLY from environment variables.
// MIGRATED: NVP endpoints removed.
define('PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID',     getenv('PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID')     ?: null); // No fallback, will cause SDK init to fail
define('PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET', getenv('PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET') ?: null); // No fallback, will cause SDK init to fail
define('PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID',    getenv('PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID')    ?: null); // No fallback, will cause webhook handler to fail
define('ADMIN_TOKEN',          getenv('ADMIN_TOKEN')          ?: null); // No fallback, will cause admin endpoints to fail

define('SHOP_CURRENCY', 'USD');
define('SHOP_BASE_URL', getenv('SHOP_BASE_URL') ?: 'http://localhost:8081');
define('SHOP_RECEIVER_EMAIL', getenv('SHOP_RECEIVER_EMAIL') ?: 'sb-business@business.example.com'); // Not used in modern flow, but kept verbatim.

$PRODUCTS = [
    'tee'    => ['name' => 'Cutover Tee',   'price' => '25.00'],
    'mug'    => ['name' => 'Rollback Mug',  'price' => '12.50'],
    'poster' => ['name' => 'Legacy Poster', 'price' => '18.00'],
];
changes: Removed NVP API credentials (PAYPAL_API_USERNAME, PAYPAL_API_PASSWORD, PAYPAL_API_SIGNATURE, PAYPAL_NVP_ENDPOINT, PAYPAL_NVP_VERSION, PAYPAL_IPN_VERIFY_URL).
Added modern PayPal API credentials (PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID, PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET) and webhook ID (PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID) and ADMIN_TOKEN.
Ensured all new credentials are read exclusively from environment variables with no hardcoded fallbacks, failing loudly if missing.

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config.php';
require __DIR__ . '/../vendor/autoload.php';

use PaypalServerSdkLib\PaypalServerSdkClientBuilder;
use PaypalServerSdkLib\Authentication\ClientCredentialsAuthCredentialsBuilder;
use PaypalServerSdkLib\Environment;
use PaypalServerSdkLib\ApiException;

$clientId = PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID;
$clientSecret = PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET;

$client = null;
$orders = null;
$payments = null;

if ($clientId && $clientSecret) {
    try {
        $client = PaypalServerSdkClientBuilder::init()
            ->clientCredentialsAuthCredentials(ClientCredentialsAuthCredentialsBuilder::init($clientId, $clientSecret))
            ->environment(Environment::SANDBOX)->build();
        $orders = $client->getOrdersController();
        $payments = $client->getPaymentsController();
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        error_log("PayPal SDK client initialization failed: " . $e->getMessage());
        // Client will remain null, calling scripts must check for it.
    }
} else {
    error_log("PayPal API credentials (PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID or PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET) are missing.");
}

// Helper function for API calls to handle exceptions consistently
function handlePayPalApiException($e) {
    if ($e instanceof ApiException) {
        $statusCode = $e->getStatusCode();
        $responseBody = $e->getResponseBody();
        error_log("PayPal API Error (Status: $statusCode): $responseBody");
        $errorData = json_decode($responseBody, true);
        $errorMessage = $errorData['message'] ?? ($errorData['details'][0]['description'] ?? 'PayPal API error');
        http_response_code(502);
        echo json_encode(['error' => $errorMessage]);
    } else {
        error_log("Unexpected error: " . $e->getMessage());
        http_response_code(500);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'An unexpected error occurred.']);
    }
    exit;
}

// Helper function for admin authentication
function authenticateAdmin() {
    $adminToken = ADMIN_TOKEN;
    $requestToken = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_ADMIN_TOKEN'] ?? '';

    if (!$adminToken) {
        error_log("ADMIN_TOKEN environment variable is not set.");
        http_response_code(500);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Admin token not configured on server.']);
        exit;
    }

    if ($requestToken !== $adminToken) {
        http_response_code(401);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Unauthorized.']);
        exit;
    }
}

function orders_path() { return __DIR__ . '/../data/orders.json'; }
function orders_all() {
    $p = orders_path();
    return file_exists($p) ? (json_decode(file_get_contents($p), true) ?: []) : [];

function orders_save(array $order) {
    $all = orders_all();
    $all[$order['token']] = $order;
    file_put_contents(orders_path(), json_encode($all, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT));
}

    http_response_code(500);

curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERPWD, $clientId . ':' . $clientSecret);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, 'grant_type=client_credentials&response_type=client_token&intent=sdk_init');
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ['Accept: application/json', 'Accept-Language: en_US']);

$response = curl_exec($ch);
$httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
curl_close($ch);

if ($httpCode === 200) {
    $data = json_decode($response, true);
    echo json_encode(['clientToken' => $data['access_token']]);
} else {
    error_log("Failed to get client token: HTTP $httpCode - $response");
    http_response_code(502);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Failed to retrieve client token from PayPal.']);
}

<?php
// Step 1 of Express Checkout: SetExpressCheckout, returns the EC token to checkout.js.
// MIGRATED: Now creates a PayPal Order using Orders v2 API.
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/paypal_sdk.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/orders_store.php';
header('Content-Type: application/json');

use PaypalServerSdkLib\Models\Builders\{OrderRequestBuilder, PurchaseUnitRequestBuilder, AmountWithBreakdownBuilder, AmountBreakdownBuilder, ItemBuilder, MoneyBuilder};
use PaypalServerSdkLib\ApiException;

if (!$orders) {
    http_response_code(500);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'PayPal SDK not initialized.']);
    exit;
}

// checkout.js v4 posts either JSON or a classic form body depending on the call; accept both.
$cart = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?: $_POST;
$total = 0.0; $items = [];
foreach ($cart as $sku => $qty) {
    if (!isset($PRODUCTS[$sku])) continue;
    $p = $PRODUCTS[$sku];
    $itemPrice = number_format((float)$p['price'], 2, '.', '');
    $itemQty = (string)(int)$qty; // Quantity must be a string
    if ((int)$itemQty > 0) {
        $items[] = ItemBuilder::init($p['name'], MoneyBuilder::init(SHOP_CURRENCY, $itemPrice)->build(), $itemQty)->build();
        $total += (float)$itemPrice * (int)$itemQty;
    }
}
$total = number_format($total, 2, '.', '');

if ((float)$total <= 0) { http_response_code(400); echo json_encode(['error' => 'empty cart']); exit; }

try {
    $purchaseUnit = PurchaseUnitRequestBuilder::init(
        AmountWithBreakdownBuilder::init(SHOP_CURRENCY, $total)
            ->breakdown(AmountBreakdownBuilder::init()->itemTotal(MoneyBuilder::init(SHOP_CURRENCY, $total)->build())->build())
            ->build()
    )->items($items)->build();

    $orderRequest = OrderRequestBuilder::init('CAPTURE', [$purchaseUnit])->build();

    $r = $orders->createOrder(['body' => $orderRequest, 'prefer' => 'return=representation']);
    $orderId = $r->getResult()->getId();

    orders_save(['token' => $orderId, 'amount' => $total, 'status' => 'CREATED', 'created' => date('c'), 'currency' => SHOP_CURRENCY]);
    echo json_encode(['id' => $orderId]);

} catch (ApiException $e) {
    handlePayPalApiException($e);
} catch (Exception $e) {
    error_log("Unexpected error in create-payment: " . $e->getMessage());
    http_response_code(500);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'An unexpected error occurred.']);
    exit;
}
changes: Replaced NVP `SetExpressCheckout` with PayPal Orders v2 `createOrder` API call using the PHP Server SDK.
Constructed `OrderRequestBuilder` with `CAPTURE` intent and `PurchaseUnitRequestBuilder` for cart items and total.
Mapped legacy cart items to `ItemBuilder` objects, ensuring quantity is a string.
Updated order storage to save the new PayPal Order ID (as 'token') and currency.
Changed JSON response from `{"token": ...}` to `{"id": ...}` to align with JS SDK v6 expectations.
Implemented error handling using `handlePayPalApiException` for SDK errors.

<?php
// Steps 2 and 3: GetExpressCheckoutDetails then DoExpressCheckoutPayment, called after the buyer approves.
// MIGRATED: Now captures the PayPal Order using Orders v2 API.
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/paypal_sdk.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/orders_store.php';
header('Content-Type: application/json');

use PaypalServerSdkLib\ApiException;

if (!$orders) {
    http_response_code(500);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'PayPal SDK not initialized.']);
    exit;
}

$in = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?: $_POST;
$orderId = $in['orderId'] ?? ''; // JS SDK v6 sends orderId

$order = orders_get($orderId);
if (!$order) { http_response_code(404); echo json_encode(['error' => 'unknown order ID']); exit; }

// Security fix: Payment confirmation has replay guard (idempotency).
// If the order is already paid, return the stored transaction ID.
if ($order['status'] === 'PAID') {
    echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'transactionId' => $order['transaction_id'], 'amount' => $order['amount']]);
    exit;
}

try {
    // Get order details to retrieve payer email (replaces GetExpressCheckoutDetails)
    $paypalOrder = $orders->getOrder(['id' => $orderId]);
    $payerEmail = $paypalOrder->getResult()->getPayer()->getEmailAddress() ?? '';
    $payerId = $paypalOrder->getResult()->getPayer()->getPayerId() ?? '';

    // Capture the order (replaces DoExpressCheckoutPayment)
    $captureResponse = $orders->captureOrder(['id' => $orderId, 'prefer' => 'return=representation']);
    $captureId = $captureResponse->getResult()->getPurchaseUnits()[0]->getPayments()->getCaptures()[0]->getId();

    $order['status'] = 'PAID';
    $order['payer_id'] = $payerId;
    $order['transaction_id'] = $captureId;
    $order['payer_email'] = $payerEmail;
    orders_save($order);

    echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'transactionId' => $order['transaction_id'], 'amount' => $order['amount']]);

} catch (ApiException $e) {
    // Handle ORDER_ALREADY_CAPTURED specifically for idempotency
    if ($e->getStatusCode() === 422) {
        $errorData = json_decode($e->getResponseBody(), true);
        if (($errorData['details'][0]['issue'] ?? '') === 'ORDER_ALREADY_CAPTURED') {
            // Attempt to retrieve the capture ID from the order if it was already captured by PayPal
            try {
                $paypalOrder = $orders->getOrder(['id' => $orderId]);
                $captures = $paypalOrder->getResult()->getPurchaseUnits()[0]->getPayments()->getCaptures();
                if (!empty($captures)) {
                    $captureId = $captures[0]->getId();
                    $order['status'] = 'PAID';
                    $order['transaction_id'] = $captureId;
                    orders_save($order);
                    echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'transactionId' => $order['transaction_id'], 'amount' => $order['amount']]);
                    exit;
                }
            } catch (Exception $innerE) {
                error_log("Failed to retrieve capture details for already captured order $orderId: " . $innerE->getMessage());
            }
        }
    }
    handlePayPalApiException($e);
} catch (Exception $e) {
    error_log("Unexpected error in execute-payment: " . $e->getMessage());
    http_response_code(500);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'An unexpected error occurred.']);
    exit;
}
changes: Implemented replay guard: checks `order['status']` before attempting capture, returning stored transaction if already `PAID`.
Replaced NVP `GetExpressCheckoutDetails` with `orders->getOrder()` to retrieve payer information.
Replaced NVP `DoExpressCheckoutPayment` with `orders->captureOrder()` to capture the approved order.
Updated input parameter from `token` and `payerID` to `orderId` to match JS SDK v6.
Updated order storage with the PayPal Capture ID (as 'transaction_id'), payer ID, and payer email.
Handled `ORDER_ALREADY_CAPTURED` (HTTP 422) error to ensure idempotency, retrieving existing capture ID if available.
Implemented error handling using `handlePayPalApiException` for SDK errors.

<?php
// Admin-style refund using the classic RefundTransaction call.
// MIGRATED: Now uses Payments v2 API for refunds.
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/paypal_sdk.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/orders_store.php';
header('Content-Type: application/json');

use PaypalServerSdkLib\ApiException;

if (!$payments) {
    http_response_code(500);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'PayPal SDK not initialized.']);
    exit;
}

// Security fix: Require admin authentication
authenticateAdmin();

$in = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?: [];
$order = orders_get($in['token'] ?? ''); // 'token' here is the PayPal Order ID
if (!$order || $order['status'] !== 'PAID') { http_response_code(400); echo json_encode(['error' => 'order is not paid']); exit; }

$captureId = $order['transaction_id'] ?? null;
if (!$captureId) { http_response_code(400); echo json_encode(['error' => 'Order has no capture ID.']); exit; }

try {
    // Refund by CAPTURE id (the NVP transaction id). Empty body = full refund.
    $refundResponse = $payments->refundCapturedPayment(['captureId' => $captureId, 'prefer' => 'return=representation']);
    $refundId = $refundResponse->getResult()->getId();

    $order['status'] = 'REFUNDED';
    $order['refund_id'] = $refundId;
    orders_save($order);
    echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'refundId' => $order['refund_id']]);

} catch (ApiException $e) {
    handlePayPalApiException($e);
} catch (Exception $e) {
    error_log("Unexpected error in refund: " . $e->getMessage());
    http_response_code(500);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'An unexpected error occurred.']);
    exit;
}

<?php
// MIGRATED: Replaces legacy IPN listener with a modern Webhook handler.
require_once __DIR__ . '/lib/orders_store.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/lib/paypal_sdk.php'; // For error handling and logging
header('Content-Type: application/json');

$webhookId = PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID;
if (!$webhookId) {
    error_log("PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID environment variable is not set.");
    http_response_code(500);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Webhook ID not configured.']);
    exit;
}

$rawBody = file_get_contents('php://input');
$headers = getallheaders();

// Extract PayPal webhook headers
$paypalHeaders = [
    'PAYPAL-AUTH-ALGO'      => $headers['PAYPAL-AUTH-ALGO'] ?? $headers['Paypal-Auth-Algo'] ?? '',
    'PAYPAL-CERT-URL'       => $headers['PAYPAL-CERT-URL'] ?? $headers['Paypal-Cert-Url'] ?? '',
    'PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-ID'=> $headers['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-ID'] ?? $headers['Paypal-Transmission-Id'] ?? '',
    'PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG'=> $headers['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG'] ?? $headers['Paypal-Transmission-Sig'] ?? '',
    'PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-TIME'=> $headers['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-TIME'] ?? $headers['Paypal-Transmission-Time'] ?? '',
];

// Check if all required headers are present
foreach ($paypalHeaders as $key => $value) {
    if (empty($value)) {
        error_log("Missing PayPal webhook header: $key");
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => "Missing PayPal webhook header: $key"]);
        exit;
    }
}

$event = json_decode($rawBody, true);
if (json_last_error() !== JSON_ERROR_NONE) {
    error_log("Invalid JSON payload: " . json_last_error_msg());
    http_response_code(400);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid JSON payload.']);
    exit;
}

// Verify webhook signature
function verifyWebhookSignature($webhookId, $paypalHeaders, $rawBody) {
    $clientId = PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID;
    $clientSecret = PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET;

    if (!$clientId || !$clientSecret) {
        error_log("PayPal API credentials not configured for webhook verification.");
        return false;
    }

    // First, get an access token
    $ch = curl_init('https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/v1/oauth2/token');
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERPWD, $clientId . ':' . $clientSecret);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, 'grant_type=client_credentials');
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ['Accept: application/json', 'Accept-Language: en_US']);
    $tokenResponse = curl_exec($ch);
    $tokenHttpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    curl_close($ch);

    if ($tokenHttpCode !== 200) {
        error_log("Failed to get access token for webhook verification: HTTP $tokenHttpCode - $tokenResponse");
        return false;
    }
    $tokenData = json_decode($tokenResponse, true);
    $accessToken = $tokenData['access_token'] ?? null;

    if (!$accessToken) {
        error_log("Access token not found in response for webhook verification.");
        return false;
    }

    // Then, verify the webhook signature
    $verifyBody = [
        'auth_algo'         => $paypalHeaders['PAYPAL-AUTH-ALGO'],
        'cert_url'          => $paypalHeaders['PAYPAL-CERT-URL'],
        'transmission_id'   => $paypalHeaders['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-ID'],
        'transmission_sig'  => $paypalHeaders['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG'],
        'transmission_time' => $paypalHeaders['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-TIME'],
        'webhook_id'        => $webhookId,
        'webhook_event'     => json_decode($rawBody) // Must be a JSON object, not string
    ];

    $ch = curl_init('https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/v1/notifications/verify-webhook-signature');
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
        'Content-Type: application/json',
        'Authorization: Bearer ' . $accessToken
    ]);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, json_encode($verifyBody));

    $verifyResponse = curl_exec($ch);
    $verifyHttpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    curl_close($ch);

    if ($verifyHttpCode !== 200) {
        error_log("Webhook verification failed: HTTP $verifyHttpCode - $verifyResponse");
        return false;
    }

    $verifyData = json_decode($verifyResponse, true);
    return ($verifyData['verification_status'] ?? '') === 'SUCCESS';
}

if (!verifyWebhookSignature($webhookId, $paypalHeaders, $rawBody)) {
    error_log("Webhook signature verification failed.");
    http_response_code(403); // Forbidden
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Webhook signature verification failed.']);
    exit;
}

// Process the event
$eventType = $event['event_type'] ?? '';
$resource = $event['resource'] ?? [];
$eventId = $event['id'] ?? ''; // For duplicate checking

// Log the event for debugging (optional, but good for webhooks)
file_put_contents(__DIR__ . '/data/webhook.log', date('c') . ' ' . $eventType . ' ' . $eventId . "\n", FILE_APPEND);

switch ($eventType) {
    case 'PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED':
        $captureId = $resource['id'] ?? null;
        $orderId = $resource['supplementary_data']['related_ids']['order_id'] ?? null;
        $amountValue = $resource['amount']['value'] ?? null;
        $currencyCode = $resource['amount']['currency_code'] ?? null;

        if (!$captureId || !$orderId || !$amountValue || !$currencyCode) {
            error_log("Missing data in PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED event: " . json_encode($event));
            http_response_code(400);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Missing data in webhook event.']);
            exit;
        }

        $order = orders_get($orderId);

        if (!$order) {
            error_log("Order $orderId not found for capture $captureId. Event ID: $eventId");
            // Respond 200 to PayPal to avoid retries, but log the issue.
            http_response_code(200);
            echo json_encode(['status' => 'Order not found, logged for review.']);
            exit;
        }

        // Idempotency check: ignore if already processed or refunded
        if ($order['status'] === 'PAID' && $order['transaction_id'] === $captureId) {
            error_log("Duplicate PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED event for order $orderId, capture $captureId. Event ID: $eventId");
            http_response_code(200);
            echo json_encode(['status' => 'Already processed.']);
            exit;
        }
        if ($order['status'] === 'REFUNDED') {
            error_log("PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED event for already refunded order $orderId, capture $captureId. Event ID: $eventId");
            http_response_code(200);
            echo json_encode(['status' => 'Order already refunded.']);
            exit;
        }

        // Verify amount and currency (security check)
        if (number_format((float)$order['amount'], 2, '.', '') !== number_format((float)$amountValue, 2, '.', '') || $order['currency'] !== $currencyCode) {
            error_log("Amount/currency mismatch for order $orderId. Expected {$order['amount']} {$order['currency']}, got $amountValue $currencyCode. Event ID: $eventId");
            // This is a critical error, might indicate fraud or misconfiguration.
            // Respond 200 to PayPal to avoid retries, but alert human.
            http_response_code(200);
            echo json_encode(['status' => 'Amount/currency mismatch, logged for review.']);
            exit;
        }

        // Update order status
        $order['status'] = 'PAID';
        $order['transaction_id'] = $captureId;
        // Payer details are not directly in PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED, but can be fetched from the order if needed.
        // For now, keep existing or fetch from orders->getOrder() if needed.
        orders_save($order);

        http_response_code(200);
        echo json_encode(['status' => 'success']);
        break;

    // Add other event types if needed (e.g., PAYMENT.CAPTURE.REFUNDED)
    default:
        error_log("Unhandled webhook event type: $eventType. Event ID: $eventId");
        http_response_code(200); // Acknowledge to avoid retries for unhandled events
        echo json_encode(['status' => 'Unhandled event type.']);
        break;
}
